entries.text: Integrating Knowledge and Skills Through Experience is satisfied through co-op.

Students can choose to complete one or two six-month co-op experiences, or none at all, during their course of study. Students must consult with their advisor regarding the prerequisite course for co-op.

A grade of C or higher is required for the public health core, science requirement, public health social science requirement, and HSCI and PHTH capstone courses. Students who take College: An Introduction ( HSCI 1000 ) and Professional Development for Bouvé Co-op ( HSCI 2000 ) must achieve a C or higher.

college: College of Social Sciences and Humanities
overview_text: The combined major in criminal justice and public health is designed to equip students to explore the intersection of crime and health at individual, community, and societal levels. Through core courses and electives, students examine how public health and criminal justice policies interrelate and influence outcomes in both fields. Graduates will be prepared for a variety of careers in criminal justice, public health, and policy development, including roles in epidemiology, community crime health, and crime prevention.
